title: The Last Reel
description: A man in a long dark coat stands in an abandoned, decaying theater projection room, pushing open ornate double doors that emit a glowing purple light with ghostly silhouettes visible beyond. The floor is littered with scattered film reels, popcorn, and old movie posters on the peeling purple walls, beneath a damaged ceiling mural and a broken crystal chandelier dripping wax.
prompt: A man in a long dark coat stands in a dilapidated old movie theater projection room, pushing open large ornate wooden doors that glow with intense purple light revealing ghostly silhouettes inside. The walls are covered in peeling purple wallpaper with torn vintage movie posters, the floor is cluttered with scattered film reels, popcorn, and old tickets. A damaged crystal chandelier hangs from a painted starry ceiling. Cinematic lighting, atmospheric and eerie, detailed digital painting.
